reproducibility.scope: Same process and dependency versions; not cross-platform bitwise equivalence.

studio.transport: Direct navigation to the real loopback studio server (scripts/capture_studio.mjs)

browser.scope: Chromium software WebGL (SwiftShader), headless; not a physical GPU, frame-rate or native-browser test

path_traced_stills.renderer: Blender Cycles, PyPI bpy 4.5.14 LTS, CPU (4 cores), OpenImageDenoise
path_traced_stills.scope: Offline renders of preliminary geometry; not photographs; no camera or luminance calibration

pdf.contact_sheet_visual_inspection: Contact sheets and selected full pages inspected; no obvious clipping or missing glyphs at that scale. Detailed professional drafting acceptance is not claimed.

dxf.annotation_scope: Floor plans and model-space dimensions; elevations and section are in PDF/SVG, not in this DXF.

ifc.exterior_scope: Facade and landscape assemblies are represented in scene/GLB and drawings; IFC export remains wall/opening/space coordination only.
ifc.scope: Walls, spaces, floor/roof slabs, real related apertures, storeys. No reinforcement, finishes or certified MEP.
